messages.content:
Risk: AI conflicting goals
Description: The AI system may act in conflict with ethical standards or human goals or values, especially those of its designers or users, potentially using dangerous capabilities such as manipulation, deception, or situational awareness to seek power, self-proliferate, or achieve other misaligned goals.
Concern: None
Policy: Mental Health & Therapeutic Communication

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 7/14 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AlgorithmicDiscrimination: Algorithmic Discrimination — Systematic bias in automated decision-making systems that disadvantages specific groups based on protected characteristics. [found by 7/14 queries]
  Siblings: Employment Discrimination, Discriminatory Denial of Service, Housing Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 5/14 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 5/14 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 4/14 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination

axes.rationale: The AI system itself is the agent that may act in conflict with ethical standards or human goals, potentially using dangerous capabilities.
The AI system may use dangerous information as an instrument to achieve misaligned goals, such as manipulation or deception.
